hero.title: Dig to the treasure before anyone else
hero.subtitle: Up to 12 miners drop into the same mine. Tunnel through dirt, rock and obsidian, survive TNT, lava and cave monsters, and be the first to break open the treasure sealed deep underground.

features.title: Every swing could change the match
features.subtitle: Gold, a Mystery Bomb… or a pocket of lava. You never know what's behind the next rock.

items.title: Dig deep
items.text: Run, jump, climb narrow shafts and fly with your jetpack. Mine coal, copper, silver, gold, emerald, ruby and diamonds as you go.

items.title: Mystery Bombs
items.text: Glowing orbs hidden in the rock. Crack one and watch it shake before it bursts: a gold shower, a jackpot… or a monster.

items.title: Traps everywhere
items.text: Hidden lava, flooding water, 3-second TNT, launcher pads, spike traps and cave collapses. Nothing dangerous shows up until you find it.

items.title: Cave monsters
items.text: Fight Cave Spiders and Stone Golems with your pickaxe, blow them up, or simply run for it.

items.title: The secret chamber
items.text: The treasure is sealed in a hidden chamber above the lava. Pick up its signal and follow your gold compass to break in first.

items.title: Play together
items.text: Quick Match online or a private room for friends. Empty seats are filled by computer miners, always labelled BOT.

items.title: Drop in
items.text: Join a Quick Match, a private room, or practice offline. Everyone starts at the surface camp.

items.title: Dig down
items.text: Tunnel through six zones, grab ore for coins, and upgrade your pickaxe, helmet, boots and armor at the shop.

items.title: Survive
items.text: Lava, TNT, launchers, spikes and monsters stand between you and the bottom. Die and you're back at the top.

items.title: Find the treasure
items.text: Follow the treasure signal, open the sealed chamber and break the treasure first to win.

items.title: No pay-to-win
items.text: Everything in the Locker is cosmetic. Digging power only comes from the in-match shop, where everyone starts from zero.

items.title: Bots are labelled
items.text: When a room needs filling, computer miners join. They always carry a BOT tag, so you know who is real.

items.title: Server decides
items.text: Every dig, blast and reward is checked by the game server, so cheats can't fake a win or a Mystery Bomb prize.

items.question: Is Mad Miners free?
items.answer: Yes. The game is free and has no ads. Coins and gems are earned by playing.

items.question: Can I play without internet?
items.answer: Yes. Practice Offline runs the whole game on your phone against computer miners. Online matches and your saved progress need an internet connection.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No sign-up form. Play as a guest with just a username, and link Google later if you want to keep your progress on another device.

items.question: Are the other players real?
items.answer: Online matches are filled with real players first. If seats are left, computer miners join, and they are always labelled BOT.

items.question: How do I delete my account?
items.answer: See the Delete account page. We remove your account and all of its game data.

cta.subtitle: The treasure won't dig itself up.
